goal: Prevent local credential leaks by requiring the default IPv4 RPC port to bind successfully during startup
Stop bitcoin-cli from transmitting RPC auth cookies to an unauthorized local process occupying the port
agreement: Broad agreement with multiple tested ACKs and all concerns resolved
Verified closing a real credential leak through testing (janb84)
Verified by building and testing on Debian with clang-20 (winterrdog)
Concept approval because bitcoin-cli defaults to IPv4 (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it fixes a direct RPC authentication security issue
Prevents local attackers from capturing auth cookies and controlling bitcoind when IPv4 bind fails
